about: The learner asks what they can do with a code repository on the canvas: what is possible, what the options are, how it can be used, or where to start. The Tutor shows the list of things to do with it.

cases.text: What can I do with this repo?
How can I use this project?
Where should I start with this code?
Show me what is possible with this repository.
What are the different ways to work with this?
I just added this repo. What now?
Remind me what I can do with the code I imported.
How does the attention mask work in model.py?
Explain the training loop in this file.
